rule: A pair passes the 30-minute test only when a duration exists for it. Durations are routed estimates (see `method`), so the filter is a shortlist, not a guarantee.
method: Official hotel and poker-room addresses were geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim and routed with the OSRM foot profile (routing.openstreetmap.de/routed-foot) on 2026-11-16, by the session that produced data/site/walking.json. A routed duration is an estimate at a typical walking pace - it is NOT a Google or Apple Maps measurement, and it does not include time spent inside a casino, at crossings, or waiting for a lift. Every row carries a prefilled Google Maps and Apple Maps directions link so you can confirm the pair yourself in one tap.
